Policy-side notes (do not change this skill's verdict):
- landlord_ext_returned_payment_fee: the rule says the fee is "rounded to the cent once at the end", while compute rounds the 2.5 percent basis separately (`fee_basis: RND(K('large_returned_share') * returned_amount, 2)`) before the dollar additions and the ageing reduction; returned_payment_size_basis carries the compute's intermediate rounding ("2.5 percent of the returned payment, rounded to the cent"). The two readings can differ by a cent for returned payments of 1000.00 or more whose 2.5 percent has a third decimal (e.g. 1000.20 at 0.50 ageing: 12.51 vs 12.50). Not triggered in this task (returned payment 492.38, flat-basis band). Nature: rule-vs-compute inconsistency on the source side.
